title: Would you pick your strongest model to coordinate other agents? Results from WorkflowArena [R]
summary: Suppose you’re putting together a team of agents. Picking the strongest model as the coordinator seems reasonable. We wanted to test whether its workflows would actually help other models do the work. In one experiment, we gave Opus 5.5 and GPT-6 Astra the same 32 challenging tas
